featured_reviews.name: Nagin Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Japan, the land of rising sun is a home to a Plethora of tourist attractions ranging from awe-inspiring temples & shrines to bustling shopping districts & serene natural land scape. To explore these things, we had decided to visit Japan this year and as Aurora Travels was a reputed name conducting the tours of Japan, we booked the Trip with them on a departure of 19/05/2026. After returning from the tour all I can say that, this was a worst tour of my life and I cannot imagine how a person in hospitality business can go down to such a extent merely to earn some extra profit without any concern for the tourist who fully relied on them.
•	During predeparture get together, Ms. Shivani has specifically told the group that as soon as you land in Tokyo, you will be escorted to Hotel At Narita. However, after spending more than 15 hours in travelling we were asked to wait at Air Port for 4 hours after landing, so that tourist from the other flights can also be accommodated and ultimately dinner was served at 9.30 in the night and thereafter we were allowed to check-in at the Hotel.
•	Almost all the Hotel check-in were done after 9 PM and immediately on the next day early morning at about 5 to 6 AM was asked to check-out the Hotel which results in tiredness and fatigue.
•	The Itinerary was prepared very cleverly shown as 11 days, however only 9 days were effectively used since 1st day and last day is to be excluded.
•	It is observed that itinerary given to us was a different from the itinerary followed since the work was further delegated to an outside agency (Tour Company) (KEI IN OUR CASE).
•	In the span of 9 days of tour almost 6 different hotels were selected and that too late-night check-in and early morning check-out.
•	The alpine root did not cover the wall of ice whereas your own picture shows tourist standing out of bus on alpine road, kindly refer to page 23 of Japan itinerary given by you on 06/05/2026.
•	As mentioned earlier the itinerary given to KEI was different from the itinerary given to us in Mumbai and KEI person (Jagmohan) was following strictly his own itinerary.
•	Change in Hotel was also done without informing us and just to reduce your cost / increase your profit.
•	Tour manager and guide both were very immature and did not have any previous experience to handle such tour.
•	There was a lack of clear communication and coordination about timing, schedules and important details.
•	There was no alternative plan in between the itinerary, for example, If I do not want to go for shopping then too, I have to sit there as I was not allowed to go to the Hotel before taking the dinner. In my case I had waited for 4 hours in just a coffee shop.
•	The bus parking space was not selected properly and it was always about 1.5 km away from sight seeing point and you have to compulsory go walking that much.
•	It was promised to us that, you have your own Rajasthani Maharaj at various places who will cook and served you pure veg food. The facts was very much different as we were served food which is being prepared by Indian Restaurant serving veg as well as non veg dishes. We had before booking communicated to you and Ms. Shivani that we all are Jain and do not like to eat in restaurant serving non veg food.
•	For the first 3 days of our tour the food served to us was similar and there was no dessert too. No arrangement for afternoon tea/coffee or some snacks in between.
•	The Maharaj sent by you was just a show piece and came for tour only and was travelling with us in the same bus, how this can be accepted.
•	The transport arrangements were far below expectation and uncomfortable.
•	The bus driver was very rude and we were informed that he will not do the duty for more than 10 hours. I request you to go through your own itinerary which clearly point out the fact, his duty was more than 10 hours on each day.

It was most frustrating tour experience and instead of happy memories the tour ended with very much disappointment and frustration.

featured_reviews.review_text: Gypsy Soul Holidays helped us with our holiday to Singapore in the month of March 2026. In a short duration of 10 days Ashmi put together a wonderful 4 days vacation for us. During the planning, she gave us many options to our liking making the experience truly customised. The team that coordinated with us in Singapore during transfers were amicable and shared a lot of local trivia ensuring we were sailing smoothly and soaking in all the local touristy action. Additionally, the team coordinated very well even during our 4 days in Singapore, they were always a call away. The hotel we stayed in was in the heart of the city and the stay there was comfortable. Our Singapore trip was fun, action packed and we thank Gypsy Soul Holidays for making it a memorable vacation.

featured_reviews.name: Doshi Darshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Such an amazing travel planner. Gypsy Soul Holidays has planned our Bhutan Trip so nicely in very short notice of 4 days, since our Planned Sikkim holidays were not doable due to Cloud burst in Sikkim.

But Gypsy Soul Holidays managed to give us the best tour of Bhutan.

I strongly feel that Gypsy Soul Holidays is the best travel planner I have come across so far.

My recommendation surely goes for them.

featured_reviews.name: aashish mody
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of using gypsy soul holidays for my vacation to Lucknow and I have nothing but positive things to say about my experience. From start to finish, the entire trip was seamless and stress-free thanks to the excellent planning and execution by Ashmi at gypsy soul holidays.

Firstly, she helped me to choose the perfect itinerary for my interests and needs. She is very knowledgeable about the city of Lucknow and was able to suggest activities and attractions that I wouldn't have known about otherwise. They were also very flexible and accommodating when it came to making changes to the itinerary.

The accommodation that Ashmi arranged for me was exceptional. I stayed in a lovely hotel that was conveniently located near the main attractions of the city. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities I needed for a relaxing stay.

Throughout my trip, I was impressed by the quality of the tours and transportation that were arranged by her. The tour guides were knowledgeable and passionate about the city's history and culture, and the drivers were always on time and very professional.

Overall, I would highly recommend Gypsy Soul Holidays to anyone planning a trip to Lucknow. Their expertise, attention to detail, and excellent customer service made my vacation unforgettable. I will definitely be using their services again in the future.

featured_reviews.name: G. P.
featured_reviews.review_text: Dharia was the perfect organizer for our family vacation in India. She understood the needs of the group and provided a great service before and during the trip, liaising with every local partner. She reacted very promptly even when a national flight got canceled on short notice. Thank you Dharia!

featured_reviews.name: Peter Bamert
featured_reviews.review_text: We were very happy with Gypsy Soul Holidays across the board, starting from the high quality itinerary, hotel selection, drivers and guides, on to the high responsiveness and dedicated support during the journey! We will chose Gypsy Soul Holidays again in the future and can highly recommend the agency.

featured_reviews.name: Payal Dhanak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Booking with Gypsy Soul Holidays was fantastic, and the actual trip blew us away!

Ashmi's expertise and understanding of our preferences were evident throughout the planning process. From crafting the perfect itinerary to seamless paperwork, every detail was spot on. We loved the personalized service and clear communication.

The Cordelia cruise was a blast! Great ship, top-notch amenities, and the perfect mix of relaxation, adventure, and quality family time.

Thanks to Gypsy Soul Holidays, we had a memorable trip and made memories we'll cherish forever. Can't wait for our next adventure with you!

featured_reviews.name: Beat Wyler
featured_reviews.review_text:
A truly unforgettable travel experience! Our trip to India was a once-in-a-lifetime highlight – perfectly organized and filled with memorable moments. Amritsar was a wonderful surprise, and of course, the Taj Mahal was a major highlight – almost crowd-free thanks to great planning.

The itinerary was well thought out, the accommodations were beautiful and comfortable – especially in Agra and Jaipur. Our drivers were always reliable and helpful, and the guides provided not only great insights but also meaningful conversations about life in India.

We felt well taken care of at all times and can highly recommend Gypsy Soul Holidays to anyone looking to explore India in a personal, safe, and inspiring way. Thank you for making this journey so special!

featured_reviews.name: Darius Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first experience with Gypsy Soul Holidays. When contacted, Ashmi provided us with a few locations for travel and we chose Bali. She then went on to enquire on how we would want to spend our time, which activities we'd prefer to do, locations to visit etc. and went to curate our trip. With a few modifications we went ahead.

Our trip was excellent! We enjoyed every bit of this trip because nearly after a decade only the two of us travelled. Ashmi was prompt in sending me the boarding passes, informing of the departure gate, informing of the delayed flight & what we could do in the waiting time at the airport. She asked for the day's feedback each day so that the experience would be worthwhile. It was all taken care of so well... And I feel that's what people who travel want - Zero headaches. I'm sure, my next trip will be through Gypsy Soul Holidays.

Just wanted to say a big THANK YOU for arranging such a smooth 5D/4N trip to Andaman for us. From the welcome cake at Eastern Gate Hotel to the jetty bookings, hotels, and activities — everything was seamless.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful trip to the Maldives, even though it was planned very suddenly. We approached Journey Label  and they guided us very well with all the available options.
Tanuj was extremely proactive and took the time to understand our needs and preferences. Since we had very little time to plan, the team was highly agile and ensured that everything—from travel arrangements to our stay—was smooth and hassle-free.
The resort they recommended, Villa Nautica, was absolutely beautiful—luxurious, prime, and truly breathtaking. The staff were very courteous, and Glory the guest relation officer  was a fantastic host who made our experience even more special.
Overall, it was a truly memorable and wonderful experience.

featured_reviews.name: Rupal Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would like to extend our heartfelt appreciation to The Journey Label for flawlessly organizing our recent tour to Mauritius. From the moment we embarked on this unforgettable journey, every detail was thoughtfully curated to ensure a seamless and enriching experience.

The itinerary was perfectly balanced, allowing us to immerse ourselves in the breathtaking natural beauty, vibrant culture, and unique charm that Mauritius offers. Your team's professionalism and dedication were evident in every aspect—from smooth travel arrangements and comfortable accommodations to engaging excursions and attentive support throughout the trip.

Thanks to The Journey Label, we not only explored stunning landscapes and serene beaches but also created lasting memories with an expertly designed travel experience that exceeded our expectations. Your commitment to excellence has truly made this tour exceptional, and we are grateful for the care and effort invested in making our time in Mauritius so special.

We look forward to future adventures with The Journey Label and will enthusiastically recommend your services to friends and family seeking extraordinary travel experiences. Thank you once again for turning our dream trip into a beautiful reality.

Special thanks to Zamzama ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Vanessa Janice
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would like to sincerely thank Journey Label and Tanuj for arranging such a wonderful Mahabaleshwar getaway for us.

From the seamless hotel booking at Le Méridien Mahabaleshwar Resort & Spa to the smooth travel arrangements and thoughtfully planned sightseeing, everything was perfectly organized. The Tranquility Suite amidst the forest and the chirping birds to the Giant Squirrel encounter during our stay truly enhanced our overall experience and made it extra special.

We absolutely loved the strawberry picking experience at Laxmi Farms, which was such a refreshing and unique activity. Our visit to Mapro Garden was delightful, and exploring Arthur's Seat Point and Kate's Point was absolutely breathtaking. Each location, with its own historic significance and panoramic mountain views, added depth and beauty to our stay.

Thank you for your thoughtful planning, attention to detail, and for creating such a memorable and seamless travel experience for us. We truly appreciate it and look forward to planning many more journeys with you. 🌿✨

Deekshith and Vanessa😊

featured_reviews.name: Prithiv Sassisegarane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Trip number 4 with JourneyLabel and as usual Zamzama and team's attention to detail and customisations were amazing. Right from the selection of properties and selection of transition points, a lot of care was put into making our journey and vacation seamless and enjoyable to the hilt.

JL organised a week-long escapade in the Andamans with a specific focus on scuba diving experiences - I got open water certified. They picked the best dive shop and the best properties to stay at.

Already planning our next scuba trip with JL. Can't wait...

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Redkar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a great experience, thanks to JourneyLabel's expertise!!!! Our tour to Vietnam and Cambodia was well curated keeping our individual interests and preferences in mind. The daily updates and guidance to make the day fruitful was well appreciated. The prompt ever-available support came handy when we could not locate our transportation at airport, as well as to address our concerns regarding visa. The road transport vehicles were top notch. The drivers and guides were friendly and knowledgeable. Overall, we had great time, thanks to JourneyLabel!!!!

featured_reviews.name: Ishaan Srivastav
featured_reviews.review_text: We had the pleasure of taking the inside CSMT (Crown Jewel of Mumbai) tour with Sarthak Mahajan, and he was exceptional. Sarthak is incredibly knowledgeable, seamlessly weaving together stories of the building’s storied past with insights into its present-day operations. His passion for the history of the station is evident, and he made the entire walk a very pleasant, fun and engaging experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to truly understand the soul of this UNESCO World Heritage site!

featured_reviews.name: Carol Thomson
featured_reviews.review_text:
The CST tour was a great experience.
It really felt like stepping into a whole different world full of history and amazing architecture.

Our guide, Sarthak, was exceptional. He eloquently walked us through the evolution of Indian Railways and the fascinating story behind CST, bringing every detail to life.
He also took us to all the best spots, which made it even better.

The architecture is just beautiful and so diverse—you can really see why it’s a UNESCO World Heritage site.

Overall, it was a memorable time and I’m really grateful to Sarthak for all the insights and knowledge that he shared.

featured_reviews.name: Samar Devdass
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved the grand heritage walk of CSMT station. Very well conducted tour. Our tour guide Sarthak Mahajan was warm and welcoming. Taking us around in an easy pace allowing us to soke-in every moment.

Though the property is a UNESCO World heritage site, it is in a very bad state of up-keep, especially the interiors. If we don't take care of it now it will just wither away. We are answerable to the next generation. Looking forward to more such tours. Thanks

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today i.e. 17/01/26, I attended The Crown Jewel of Mumbai - Inside CSMT tour hosted by Ms. Shravani of Raconteur tours, it was a wonderful experience.
Very well explained by the host Ms. Shravani with very detailed information about our Railway history n CSMT Building structure.

Would highly recommend this tour to everyone and can be added as one of the visit places in itinerary for Mumbai.

Wishing all the best to host n the tour agency.

Best regards,
Trupti Rane

featured_reviews.name: Huda Dalwai
featured_reviews.review_text: Wonderful experience, lots of fun. Our guide Shravani was very knowledgeable and kind. She answered all our questions and made the tour very interactive. Giving her a five star as well!!!!

featured_reviews.name: dhanwanti rajwade
featured_reviews.review_text: We went with two kids, aged 13 and 10 for the Crown Jewel of India walk with Pankaj. He was an outstanding guide! He engaged all age groups, was patient, was entertaining and had a real passion for the subject, which was evident in his delivery. I would love to go for many more walks with him, and highly recommend this experience for anyone in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: E Marbach
featured_reviews.review_text: What a great time we had with Sarthak. He knew so much about the railway and we had really good discussions with him about India and Britain and rail history and architecture. It was really worth going to the station with a guide. It brought it all to life and we noticed more than we ever would have.

featured_reviews.name: Binki Gundavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited with my relatives from London as tourists...on 20 th Jan.2026 Tuesday. The crown jewel of Mumbai. Inside CSMT tour.
It was an awesome experience, a very proud feeling too of our heritage culture and values...got lots of detailed and minute information from our tour guide Mr. Sarthak, he is a very friendly person, with perfect knowledge of his subject and he could answer queries of other tourists and ours too very smoothly and clearly...he threw light on so many minute details which I was not aware of as a Mumbaikar...
I suggest that everyone must take this tour once, as a tourist to learn more about our very own heritage culture and values and places.
